fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (40.5595,-89.7482) is ROOFTOP and lands on the Caterpillar Mapleton Foundry. Confirmed: large heavy-industrial foundry complex with rust-colored foundry building roofs, sand/material handling structures to the SW, employee parking, and a wastewater treatment plant to the SE - consistent with the gray-iron casting foundry on US-24 (8826 W US-24).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole complex enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing (confirmed in Street View on the south road). Truck access is via the internal access road that connects to US-24; the gate/checkpoint is set inside the property along the entrance drive.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth resolvable from public roads - US-24 Street View does not reach the gate. Classified remoteGs (controlled fenced foundry, internal checkpoint, no road-visible booth); low confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The entrance access road off US-24 runs a long distance before reaching the building/dock area - ample queue depth.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked along the foundry's east building face plus material laydown; trailer drop capacity ~30.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line/spur runs along the SW edge with rail cars visible - the foundry is rail-served (sand/raw-material delivery; ~500 tons sand/day).
fieldNotes.scale: A foundry handling ~500 tons of sand/day inbound almost certainly has a truck scale; a scale-like pad is suggested near the sand-handling area on the SW. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 6+ large connected/adjacent foundry, finishing and material-handling buildings.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~14 dock doors estimated along the east building face; many obscured by trailers and structures - low confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the foundry sits among farmland and woods along US-24 by the Illinois River, well outside any town.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~200 acres for the fenced foundry complex including material yards - approximate.
